title: Kassa
description: Kenari was a lush jungle planet, long abandoned after a mining accident. A band of young children were left as survivors, including Kassa and his younger sister, Kerri. When a ship crash-landed, a group of children, including Kassa, went to investigate it. There, he found himself whisked away to a different planet and a new life by Clem and Maarva Andor who adopted him as "Cassian".
